'''February 2001 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Smyrna, Georgia on 24 February 2001. [[John Digiovanni]] won it. It is known from John Digiovanni's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1778">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-smyrna-ga-2-24-2001d1778/ smyrna-ga-2-24-2001], DeckTech (John "Parn12" Digiovanni, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-smyrna-ga-2-24-2001d1778/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[John Digiovanni]]
